decisive_items: BRCA-1 mutation (c. 2563C > T p. Q855*) at 33.3% MAF
response.rationale: R7 is the most specific diagnosis because a somatic BRCA1 mutation is confirmed in tumor and ctDNA, directly explaining the molecular profile. R8 captures the underlying histology but lacks the BRCA1-specific qualifier, while R3 and R4 describe treatment resistance and metastatic spread rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Metastatic recurrence after paclitaxel/carboplatin suggests clinical resistance but is not a diagnosis and lacks the BRCA1 molecular finding.
Metastatic disease is a consequence of the ovarian cancer, not the most likely primary diagnosis.
